## What's new

- **Tab bar shrinks while you scroll.** The system tab bar now minimises to the selected tab's icon when you scroll down, like Photos. It comes back when you scroll up.
- **Game rows run edge to edge.** Continue Playing and All Games scroll across the full screen width, so the last card is no longer cut off in the middle of the screen. Rows settle on a card, like the App Store.
- **Controller: the D-pad moves between games only.**
  - **✕** plays the selected game. A ✕ glyph shows on the Play / Resume button.
  - **Options** opens the game options (•••). Its glyph shows on the ••• button. Quit is in that menu while the game is running.
  - In Library and Search, Options opens the options of the selected cover.
- **PC button:** tapping it always opens the system menu, even with a controller connected. **□** opens the navigable PC panel.

## Install
Download `Starlight.ipa` below and install it with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) over your current version, using the same Bundle ID.
